question: Do the selected vehicle/environment records provide a usable common time axis and distinguish scenario events, system messages and actual monitored outcomes?
exposure: Prior TD2D results, manD descriptor, dictionary and coverage metadata exposed; no manD trial bytes parsed or viewed at this freeze. This is source qualification, not blinded model evaluation.
selection_rule: Lowest participant ID, then first ordered non-familiarization scenario marked driven with both required channels available; no outcome, demographic or smallest-archive selection
coverage_caution: Available and driven metadata do not prove recording completeness or an uncensored recovery outcome. Owner question requests a complete run; verification may reject that premise.

source.terms: Public unrestricted released file under retained CC BY 4.0 metadata; keep original compressed payload and trial streams private. Only attributed derived observations published.

archive_plan: Capture at most P1.7z; verify advertised complete length/MD5. Inspect bsdtar listing with no network, no arbitrary file writes. Extract only the first anger scenario archive if uniquely identified; then only EnvironmentState.txt and VehicleState.txt. Stream exact selected members to bounded outputs with a 512 MiB combined extraction cap, 300-second extraction operation deadline and 2 GiB disk reserve. Do not unpack DriverState or run upstream code. Stop if absent, ambiguous, path-unsafe, oversized or unsupported.
source_code_review: DataExtraction.py recursively extracts all archives and deletes originals; it also contains sensor feature calculations. Read only, not executed or imported. It does not define vehicle/environment capture timestamps.
observations: Unique headers, exact source bytes and counts; preserve nonnumeric/missing/sentinel states.
Stored time value units/origin, strict monotonicity, exact adjacent differences and cross-file equality/offset. Do not infer seconds merely from 256 Hz documentation.
Enumerate observed integer EnvironmentalEvent, InteractionSignal and AutomationMode values, contiguous runs and their boundaries. Do not round fractional codes.
Check beginning/end of monitoring around TOR, accident and end-message codes; distinguish no observation from negative outcome.
Retain dataset-described native20Hz vs delivered256Hz; neither delivered spacing nor concordance establishes collision latency, common recovery horizon or physical success.
conventional_reference: Separate standard-library decimal/rational calculations and read-only SQL over identical selected fields; full-row/source digest checks, no model comparison.
acceptance: Qualify only the observation semantics supported by records and release-linked documentation. Readiness labels require known outcome event meaning and monitored horizon/censoring; abstain if missing.
stops: No replacement participant/scenario if selected source fails; no broader cohort, recovery labels, feature/model work or endpoint repair in this owner.
